sample_unit: benchmark items (100 clinical vignettes and 150 internal medicine exam questions)

links.outcome: Accuracy of RAG-grounded HomeDOCtor versus stand-alone ChatGPT-4o on Slovenian national exam questions
links.effect: HomeDOCtor with RAG over curated guidelines achieved 90.7% versus 80.7% for stand-alone ChatGPT-4o (p = 0.0135).
links.quote: On international benchmarks, the system achieved ≥95% Top-1 diagnostic accuracy, comparable to leading medical AI platforms, and significantly outperformed stand-alone ChatGPT-4o in the national context (90.7% vs. 80.7%, p = 0.0135).

unlisted_practices: Nationally localized adaptation of a conversational AI to a country's language and guidelines
Autonomous 24/7 AI triage and self-care guidance to reduce clinician burden

screen.reason: The study reports on a six-month nationwide real-world deployment of a patient-facing conversational AI platform (HomeDOCtor) and evaluates performance comparisons with standalone general LLMs (ChatGPT-4o) using localized RAG with national guidelines.

primary.practice: national localization and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using curated medical guidelines
